text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her debut race now before her, Vodka is burning up the scene. But when she sees how laid back her competitors are, she feels let down.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On top of that, if she loses to one of them, Vodka will think of herself as lame.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Not wanting to make a half-hearted debut, Vodka lifts her spirits and heads to the paddock.
